primary_identity_evidence.primary_entity_class: bacteriocins and bacteriocin-like inhibitory substances used as assay reagents against MRSA strains
primary_identity_evidence.primary_identity_description: The paper tests 13 bacteriocins isolated from Enterococcus and Lactococcus spp. against 40 MRSA strains. It gives names, producer bacteria, source of isolation, assay method, and activity ranges, but no peptide sequence or modification-level identity record for any bacteriocin.

assay_method_evidence.summary: Activity was tested only against MRSA strains using agar spot testing; two-fold dilutions of bacteriocins were applied to BHIA overlay plates and activities were expressed in AU/mL.

caution_summary: No candidate row is marked source_verified at the record level because each row is a Codex fallback candidate, not an authoritative DBAASP-linked record.

Primary source evidence verifies bacteriocin names, producer/source-of-isolation context, source-paper citation, and activity ranges or no-effect calls, but it does not report any peptide sequences or modification chemistry.
The fallback rows contain target-organism assay fields but no source-organism/source-isolation field; source organism agreement cannot be checked at database-record level.
Authoritative linked article, assay, sequence, and literature record snapshots are all empty for this paper.
Rows 14-16 appear to be footnote-marker parsing artifacts for L.l MK 2/8, L.l MK 2/2, and L.l MK 2/7 and are preserved as source_conflict rather than silently merged.
